#region Setup
#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace Demo;

/* Block comment */
public sealed record Point(int X, int Y);

public static class Program
{
    private const decimal Price = 19.99m;

    public static async Task<int> Main(string[] args)
    {
        var name = args.Length > 0 ? args[0] : null;
        string path = @"C:\temp\""quoted"" file.txt";
        string greeting = $"Hello, {name ?? "world"}! {{braces}} {Price:C}";
        string both = $@"Dir: {path}\sub";
        string raw = """
            Raw "text" \n stays
            """;
        char c = '\'', tab = '\t', hex = '\x41', uni = '\u00e9';
        long big = 1_000_000L + 0xFFu + 0b1010;
        double d = 1.5e-3d + .5f;
        bool ok = true && !false;
        await Task.Delay(10);
        Console.WriteLine(greeting + both + raw + c + tab + hex + uni + big + d + ok);
        return ok ? 0 : 1;
    }
}
#endregion
